options: To write compressed flight logs to the SD card
To merge noisy sensors into one estimate
To keep the link to the GCS
To drive the motors
questions.explain: One consistent estimate of position, velocity and attitude: prediction from the IMU, correction with infrequent GPS/baro/compass measurements.

options: Changing the video transmitter channel when there is interference
Switching to a healthier EKF core
Switching to a backup mission
Automatic flight mode change
questions.explain: Each IMU has its own EKF core; the healthiest one is used.

options: Heading from the compass
Heading from GPS velocity (GSF)
Heading is not estimated
Heading from an external navigation system
questions.explain: It only works while moving — on the ground there is no heading.

questions.q: What do you do about the pre-arm “EKF compass variance”?
options: Raise FS_EKF_THRESH to 1.0 and take off
Look for interference and check the calibration
Disable the EKF check
Take off — it will go away by itself
questions.explain: Interference, calibration, compass orientation. The threshold is not a cure.

options: Only report to the GCS
Land if the mode requires position
Switch to AltHold
Land from any mode, even from Stabilize
questions.explain: 0 — report, 1 — Land if the mode requires position, 2 — AltHold, 3 — always Land.

questions.q: Why was EKF3 disabled in the HeeWing case?
options: EKF3 does not support the QuadPlane configuration
No compass and an unstable GPS
The controller ran out of memory
It makes the loop run faster
questions.explain: No compass and an unstable GPS — they chose DCM and modes without position: a deliberate compromise for specific hardware.

options: The compass is healthy and calibrated
The compass is being rejected by the gate
The GPS signal is lost
The barometer reports a wrong altitude
questions.explain: The square of the innovation-to-allowed ratio is > 1: interference or calibration.

options: The radius of a circular geofence around the home point
The threshold for resetting the position to GPS
The width of the compass gate
The required RTK accuracy
questions.explain: The discrepancy with GPS after which the position is reset to GPS. Larger is more tolerant of glitches, but the drift lasts longer.

questions.q: An XKF4 fragment during position jumps. What is happening?
options: The GPS velocity and position test ratios are > 1 — the EKF is rejecting GPS: a glitch or multipath
SH around 0.3 means the barometer is rejected and altitude comes from GPS only
SM around 0.2 is a sign of magnetic interference: the compass is rejected, hence the position jumps
Values above 1 mean the filter is highly confident in GPS, and the position jumps are caused by wind gusts
questions.explain: A test ratio > 1 means the measurement did not pass the gate; here that is SV and SP, i.e. GPS.
